name: Deploy to Fly

# Deploys crates/opentunnel-server and the website (Dockerfile, fly.toml) to the `opentunnel` Fly app on every
# push to master that changes them, blue-green (fly.toml). Uses the FLY_API_TOKEN repository secret
# (`fly tokens create deploy -a opentunnel`). Runtime secrets persist on the app and are not set here.

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]
    paths:
      - "crates/opentunnel/**"
      - "crates/opentunnel-server/**"
      - "packages/website/**"
      - "index.html"
      - "vite.config.ts"
      - "Cargo.toml"
      - "Cargo.lock"
      - "Dockerfile"
      - "fly.toml"
      - ".github/workflows/fly-deploy.yml"
  workflow_dispatch:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy opentunnel on Fly
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # A pinned flyctl release, verified against its published checksum, since this job holds the deploy token.
      - name: Install flyctl
        env:
          FLYCTL_VERSION: 0.4.120
          FLYCTL_SHA256: ef9b938ff3af2b28fad961a676e5ac2295124ad0b892ffb1c5f16a03bd4ee378
        run: |
          archive="$RUNNER_TEMP/flyctl.tar.gz"
          curl -fsSL -o "$archive" "https://github.com/superfly/flyctl/releases/download/v${FLYCTL_VERSION}/flyctl_${FLYCTL_VERSION}_Linux_x86_64.tar.gz"
          echo "$FLYCTL_SHA256  $archive" | sha256sum --check --strict
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/flyctl"
          tar -xzf "$archive" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/flyctl" flyctl
          echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/flyctl" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

      # Blue-green needs Fly to place a second machine per region at once, which fails whenever one region is
      # short on capacity (the deploy rolls back untouched). Retry a few times, then replace machines in place,
      # one at a time, which needs no extra capacity; the server drains connections on SIGTERM either way.
      - name: Deploy
        env:
          FLY_API_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.FLY_API_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          flyctl deploy --remote-only --config fly.toml --build-only --push --image-label "$GITHUB_SHA"
          image="registry.fly.io/opentunnel:$GITHUB_SHA"
          for attempt in 1 2 3; do
            flyctl deploy --config fly.toml --image "$image" && exit 0
            echo "::warning::blue-green deploy attempt $attempt failed (usually Fly capacity in one region); retrying"
            sleep 60
          done
          echo "::warning::falling back to a rolling deploy"
          flyctl deploy --config fly.toml --image "$image" --strategy rolling

name: check

on:
  push:
    branches: ["**"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["**"]

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2

      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - run: bun run ready

      - run: bun run --filter '*' test

  rust:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@b725eda525362e7cf34af9a7243cac1e3f01a7ec # stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          components: rustfmt, clippy

      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@d1527c8f67ef9af357290475d4af4b0fab8f12e0 # v2.9.3

      - run: cargo fmt --all --check

      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings

      - run: cargo test --workspace --locked

name: Publish

on:
  push:
    branches: [master]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions: {}

jobs:
  select-mode:
    name: Select mode
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      mode: ${{ steps.changesets.outputs.mode }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - id: changesets
        uses: changesets/action/select-mode@ae32849d5ba541f9ae29e40e22a623bc13562f51 # v2.1.2

  version:
    name: Version packages
    if: needs.select-mode.outputs.mode == 'version'
    needs: select-mode
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      # Keeps the checkout's credentials: the action pushes the release branch.
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - uses: changesets/action/version@ae32849d5ba541f9ae29e40e22a623bc13562f51 # v2.1.2
        with:
          script: bun run version
          pr-title: Release packages
          commit-message: Release packages

  binaries:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.platform }}
    if: needs.select-mode.outputs.mode == 'publish'
    needs: select-mode
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
      fail-fast: true
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: linux-x64
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
          - platform: linux-arm64
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
          - platform: darwin-x64
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            runner: macos-latest
          - platform: darwin-arm64
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            runner: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@b725eda525362e7cf34af9a7243cac1e3f01a7ec # stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          targets: ${{ matrix.target }}
      - if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get install -y musl-tools
      - run: |
          cargo build --release --locked -p opentunnel-cli --target ${{ matrix.target }}
          mkdir -p out/bin && cp target/${{ matrix.target }}/release/opentunnel out/bin/
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: cli-${{ matrix.platform }}
          path: out
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    name: Publish packages
    if: needs.select-mode.outputs.mode == 'publish'
    needs: [select-mode, binaries]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
    steps:
      # Keeps the checkout's credentials: the action pushes release tags.
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6.5.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: npm install --global npm@12.0.2
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@b725eda525362e7cf34af9a7243cac1e3f01a7ec # stable
        with:
          toolchain: stable
      # crates.io trusted publishing: a short-lived token for this run's cargo publish.
      - id: crates
        uses: rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action@c6f97d42243bad5fab37ca0427f495c86d5b1a18 # v1.0.5
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: bun run ready
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@d3f86a106a0bac45b974a628896c90dbdf5c8093 # v4.3.0
        with:
          pattern: cli-*
          path: artifacts
      - run: mv artifacts packages/cli/dist
      - uses: changesets/action/publish@ae32849d5ba541f9ae29e40e22a623bc13562f51 # v2.1.2
        with:
          script: bun run release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ steps.crates.outputs.token }}

  # Homebrew and AUR are published from the GitHub release in their own job, so the deploy keys are never
  # present while dependencies are installed or packages are built. Reruns are no-ops.
  distribute:
    name: Publish Homebrew formula and AUR package
    if: needs.select-mode.outputs.mode == 'publish'
    needs: [select-mode, publish]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6.1.0
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - name: Set up AUR SSH key
        env:
          AUR_KEY: ${{ secrets.AUR_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$AUR_KEY" ]; then exit 0; fi
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          echo "$AUR_KEY" > ~/.ssh/id_aur
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_aur
          printf 'Host aur.archlinux.org\n  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_aur\n  User aur\n' >> ~/.ssh/config
          ssh-keyscan -H aur.archlinux.org >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          git config --global user.name "opentunnel"
          git config --global user.email "opentunnel@anoma.ly"
          echo "AUR=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      # A deploy key on anomalyco/homebrew-tap, under its own host alias so it never stands in for github.com.
      - name: Set up Homebrew tap SSH key
        env:
          HOMEBREW_TAP_KEY: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$HOMEBREW_TAP_KEY" ]; then exit 0; fi
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh
          echo "$HOMEBREW_TAP_KEY" > ~/.ssh/id_homebrew_tap
          chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_homebrew_tap
          printf 'Host homebrew-tap.github.com\n  HostName github.com\n  User git\n  IdentityFile ~/.ssh/id_homebrew_tap\n  IdentitiesOnly yes\n' >> ~/.ssh/config
          ssh-keyscan -H github.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          git config --global user.name "opentunnel"
          git config --global user.email "opentunnel@anoma.ly"
          echo "HOMEBREW_TAP=1" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: bun packages/cli/script/distribute.ts
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
